summary.text: Dennis Hannon is a technology professional and first-time candidate running as the Republican and Conservative nominee in NY-26, challenging Rep. Timothy Kennedy. He launched his campaign in April 2026 and says his priorities are public safety, lowering costs and protecting children physically and online.

paragraphs.text: Hannon says he grew up working in his father's construction business, and he works as a technology professional. According to his Ballotpedia survey, he decided to run after becoming a parent and, in his words, fighting for his own child over medical decisions; he says he is running to put working families first.
He formally launched his campaign in April 2026 and advanced to the general election as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate without a primary.

sources.title: Dennis Hannon announces campaign for NY-26
